notes: C-16 EXTENSION POPULATION, declared BEFORE the primary run and used only if the 12 orchard-eligible games of the published 240-game panel produce no exchange on the scoping-off arm. Same referee, same seeds, same turn budget, same opponent mix as cure2-instrument-config.json; the ONLY change is class_mix, which is orchard_eligible at 1.0 so that every generated map is of the class the scoping switches off.
48 maps x 2 seats; only seat views whose own orchard_eligible predicate is true are graded, because P3 is only evaluated on those.

Existence of this file before the run is the pre-commitment: the extension is not a second look for a better number, it is a declared enlargement of a population whose primary size (12) may be too small to contain a fire.
